question.text: A simple pendulum made of mass 10 g and a metallic wire of length 10 cm is suspended vertically in a uniform magnetic field of 2 T. The magnetic field direction is perpendicular to the plane of oscillations of the pendulum. If the pendulum is released from an angle of $60^{\circ}$ with vertical, then maximum induced EMF between the point of suspension and point of oscillation is $\_\_\_\_$ mV. (Take $\mathrm{g}=10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^{2}$)
